title: Sign in with Telegram
text: Your sign-in code now arrives in Telegram, not by SMS. You can also sign in through the bot without typing your number.

title: Fiscal receipts on the Business plan
text: Receipts for visits and sales go to the tax office on their own on the Business plan and during the trial.

title: Your bookings come first
text: The Bookings tab opens on your next visit with directions and a call button. Settings open from the gear.

title: A profile like Telegram's
text: Medals, your year of visits, favourite specialists and a map of places in one profile you can share to your stories.

title: Picks made for you
text: Answer five short questions and the catalogue shows services that suit your taste, budget and what matters most to you.

title: What needs you in each business
text: My businesses shows unmarked visits, unanswered reviews, today's load and revenue.

title: Deleting a business is protected
text: To delete a business, type its page address.

title: Sign up in four short steps
text: Pick your type of business in one tap, watch your page take shape as you fill it in, and finish with a launch to remember.

title: Hide or delete a business
text: Settings has a new “Page and business” section: hide your page from the catalogue or delete the business. Upcoming bookings are cancelled and clients are told.

title: “I want this”
text: Book the same service with the same specialist straight from their work's card. The photo goes to the specialist as a reference.

title: A place's page like a profile
text: Work, services, specialists and opening hours now sit in tabs, and you can book or get in touch right from the top of the page.

title: Easier booking on your phone
text: The days sit right under the question, fields stay clear of the keyboard, and the bar shows the date, time and total before you book.

title: A profile like Settings
text: Your account on the bookings page is one row with your photo, facts and level.

title: Find a specialist by name
text: Start typing a name in search and the specialist shows up in the suggestions.

title: Photo of the work right after a visit
text: Mark “Arrived” in My day and the camera opens in one tap.

title: Show the result
text: A photo with your review goes to Looks labelled “Client's photo”.

title: Time to come back
text: Your visit history shows which services are due again.

title: Follow your specialist
text: Tap the bell on a specialist's card and we'll let you know when they have free time.

title: A specialist's followers
text: My day shows how many clients follow the specialist.

title: Several services in one visit
text: Tap “Change” on the chosen service and tick more: the specialist does them back to back, and the length and total update at once.

title: Another booking with another specialist
text: After booking, tap “Another booking” to book the same place for a time after your visit. Your name and number are already filled in.

title: Pick a specialist faster
text: On the specialist step, “Any specialist” picks whoever is free and takes you to the time.

title: Settings search keeps the page still
text: In the Android app the search field rises above the keyboard while the page stays put.

title: One more service in one tap
text: Under the chosen service we suggest what goes with it, like a beard trim with a haircut: one tap adds it to the visit with the same specialist, and your time stays if the visit still fits.

title: Booking opens at once
text: The booking sheet appears the moment you tap and fills in as it loads. The catalogue underneath stays put, and after a reload the booking stays on top of it.

title: The stack of booking steps
text: After you spread the stack with your finger, “Change” works on the first tap.

title: Gift cards online
text: Choose an amount on the place's page, pay by card, and the code goes to you and the recipient.

title: Gift cards sell themselves
text: Turn on online sales and set amounts in the loyalty settings. A paid gift card shows in the list and in profit.

title: Report with a reason
text: You can now report reviews and profiles too: choose a reason under the flag and a moderator will check it.

title: Photo hidden by a moderator
text: If a moderator hides a work photo after client reports, you'll get a Telegram message.

title: Bookings in your phone's calendar
text: Subscribe once and bookings appear in your iPhone or Google calendar on their own. Cancelled ones stay crossed out.

title: Your data, your control
text: In your profile settings you can download all your data in one file or delete your account.

title: Memberships online
text: Buy a membership on the place's page and book with it: the visit is taken off when the specialist marks it.

title: Sell memberships on your page
text: Turn on “Sell online” for a membership and clients can buy it by card on your page and when booking.

title: Specialist's share of product sales
text: In a specialist's Pay you can set a percentage of the products they sell. It goes into their pay and into My day.

title: Similar picks after booking
text: After you book, “You may also like” suggests services of the same kind you just chose.

title: Your plan in the dashboard
text: Settings > Plan shows your plan and how many specialists, branches and SMS you've used, and lets you pay for a month or a year.

title: Fiscal receipts at the till
text: Turn on “Issue receipts” and enter your tax number: product sales and paid visits get a receipt with a link and QR for the client, and cancelling a sale issues a refund receipt.

title: Several services in one visit
text: Manicure and pedicure, or a haircut and beard, in one booking with one specialist: tap “One more service” after choosing the first.

title: Visits with several services
text: Such a booking is one block in the schedule with all its services, and revenue, pay and stock count each one.

title: Booking alerts in the app
text: Owners, admins and specialists get push notifications in the Awaisa app about new, moved and cancelled bookings. A tap opens that day.

title: Memberships in profit
text: Memberships sold now count towards revenue and profit on the day of sale, on their own “Memberships” line.

title: A calmer My day and specialist sheet
text: The day's facts in one line, the visit outcome full width, and “Mark payout” full width at the bottom of the sheet.

title: Simpler profile settings
text: Icons without coloured tiles, and “Sign out” without an extra confirmation.

title: Specialists' pay
text: A percentage of services, custom rates for some services, a monthly or per-day salary and a guaranteed minimum. Analytics shows how much to pay each person, and you can mark a payout or undo it.

title: Earnings in My day
text: Specialists see how much they earned for the day and the month.

title: Till
text: Open a shift, sell products with a visit or on their own, and close the shift with a cash count.

title: Profit in analytics
text: Revenue from services and products minus materials and expenses by category.

title: Booking alerts on your phone
text: New, moved and cancelled bookings reach your phone or computer even when the dashboard is closed. Specialists only get their own. Turn it on in Settings > Notifications or in My day.

title: Client suggestions in a new booking
text: Start typing a name or number and clients who've been before appear under the field: one tap fills in the name and phone.

title: Dashboard in one tap
text: On phones the bottom menu now shows “Dashboard” instead of “Business”, and “‹” takes you back where you came from. Tap the business name to switch to another business or to My day.

title: Settings at a glance
text: Each row shows what's inside: how many branches, which promotions are running, what's running low in stock. You can also search settings.

title: Branch address without the double work
text: Start typing the address and the pin drops on the map by itself. Move the map and the address fills in.

title: Services, specialists and hours on the Page
text: Everything clients see is now edited in one place, on the Page tab.

title: A page like a social profile
text: Work, services, specialists and hours on one page in tabs, all edited right here without going to settings.

title: Your page's QR code
text: Download a QR for your counter or window and copy the link for Instagram.

title: Several work photos at once
text: Pick several photos together and tag the service and specialist one by one. Drag photos to change their order.

title: Client groups
text: New, regulars, haven't been in a while, no-shows and this week's birthdays, each on its own, and you can invite them back with a mailing.

title: Your whole client base in the list
text: Clients no longer stop at 200: the list loads more as you scroll.

title: Analytics tells you what to do
text: At the top is what needs attention: unmarked visits, clients who haven't been in a while, free slots tomorrow. Each row leads to an action.

title: A goal for the month
text: Set a revenue goal and see whether your current pace is enough.

title: Losses and return rate
text: How much money went on no-shows and late cancellations, and what share of clients come back, overall and for each specialist.

title: A quiet-hours promotion in one tap
text: Pick a quiet hour on the load map and a ready promotion for that time opens.

title: Your week in Telegram
text: Every Monday you get a summary: revenue, visits, the best specialist, no-shows and reviews.

title: Answer reviews in one tap
text: The reply field sits right under the review, with quick replies, an auto-reply to good ratings and “Reply to all” for ratings without text.

title: Poor reviews first
text: “Message the client” with a ready apology and promo code, and a “Resolved” mark once you've sorted it out.

title: Reply to reviews from Telegram
text: Quick-reply buttons under each new review and a weekly summary every Monday.

title: Reviews of specialists
text: Each specialist's rating in analytics, and specialists see their own reviews in My day.

title: New sign-in
text: Your number in big digits on a dark scene lit through a prism.

title: A tidier dashboard
text: Free slots, clients, analytics, schedules and loyalty look calmer: fewer extra backgrounds, buttons of one height, and schedules laid out like iPhone settings.

title: Back from What's new
text: Opened the updates from the dashboard? One button takes you back to the same section.

title: Looks without the clutter
text: No more filters above the work, and the nearest to you come first.

title: A calmer profile
text: Buttons centred under your name, visit rating and “Sign out” without extra frames.

title: Schedule made easier on phones
text: Tools in a floating bar at the bottom, the day full screen, and two specialists side by side in columns.

title: Rebook a cancelled client
text: One button in a cancelled booking brings the client back at the same time with the same specialist.

title: Free slots for a service
text: Choose a service and the message shows only the slots that fit, with a link straight to it. Send it to WhatsApp or Telegram in one tap.

title: Send free slots to clients
text: A button in the schedule gathers the specialists' free time for the day into a ready message for WhatsApp or stories, with a booking link.

title: Find room for a service
text: Choose a service and the schedule highlights who has room for it and when. Tap a highlighted slot to book a client.

title: Quick actions on right-click
text: Call, message on WhatsApp, mark a visit or cancel a booking right from the schedule.

title: See how busy each day is
text: Each date has a load bar under it, and on phones you swipe between days.

title: Schedule as a timeline
text: Switch “Columns · Timeline” above the schedule: specialists run in lanes, time goes left to right, and you zoom with a pinch or the “- +” buttons.

title: Booking cards speak in colour
text: Arrivals turn green, no-shows red, and the visit under way fills up to the current time. A red line shows the time now.

title: Easier to reach a client
text: Call, WhatsApp and SMS are now separate rows in the booking and the client card.
